author: chxr1s
quote:
GTA 6 is a Massive Disappointment - Honestly, GTA 6 is one of the biggest disappointments I've experienced in gaming. First of all, the bugs are absolutely terrible. For a game of this scale, the technical issues are unacceptable. Beyond that, the story is incredibly boring. The pacing is dull, the writing is uninspired, and neither of the two main characters manages to leave any meaningful impression. Both protagonists feel completely soulless, lacking personality, depth, and genuine character development. What's even more disappointing is the complete lack of humour. GTA has always been known for its satire, dark comedy, outrageous characters, and willingness to make fun of absolutely everything. Here, there's barely any of that. The game feels overly sanitised, excessively politically correct, and afraid to take risks or offend anyone. It honestly feels like the soul of GTA has been stripped away. A franchise that was once bold, hilarious, controversial, and full of personality now feels bland, predictable, and painfully safe. For all the hype, development time, and expectations surrounding this game, I expected something extraordinary. Instead, I got a boring story, forgettable characters, endless bugs, and a game that feels like it has completely forgotten what made GTA special in the first place. Massive disappointment.

We all know this happened due to Dan Houser's departure from Rockstar, he created all the previous iconic characters, you can't expect anything good with a completely new team that don't know what it's core users want.
